(Japanese: '''ウッシー''' ''Uschi'') is a minor character who appeared in ''[[M17|Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction]]''. In the English subtitles, he was merely referred to as a '''shopper'''.

He is a porter who bumped into {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} when they followed {{an|Diancie}} around the [[Orsay City]] mall. He almost dropped his gift packages, but the others quickly grabbed them and returned them to him.

Uschi is based on his Japanese voice actor {{wp|Atsuto Uchida}}, a now-retired footballer who played for the Japanese national team and participated in the {{wp|2010 FIFA World Cup|2010}} and {{wp|2014 FIFA World Cup}}s, which the latter tournament was on course during the premiere of the film. A reference is made in that he is seen carrying a soccer ball.
